input.summary: On Abra Ca Dabra, complete 1-2-3-4 early, score the moving lit drop, and use the lit center target to reset the banks and raise their value.

steps.text: Plunge for a missing number. Prefer 2 or 3 if a 1 or 4 plunge feeds the center.
Complete 1-2-3-4 as soon as possible. The numbers carry between balls.
Shoot 1 and 4 directly. Bank a shot behind lowered drops to reach 2 or 3.
Hit the lit drop targets. Switch hits move the lit target.
If a bank is almost complete, finish its unlit targets.
When the center target lights, hit it to reset the drops and raise the target value.
Repeat. Score the lit drops at the higher value.

quickInfo.name: Number lanes
quickInfo.summary: Complete 1-2-3-4 to score and advance the lit drop-target value; number progress carries between balls.

quickInfo.name: Lit drop
quickInfo.summary: Switch hits move the lit target, so read the bank before choosing a rebound.

quickInfo.name: Center reset
quickInfo.summary: After the required bank progress, the lit center target resets the drops and raises their value.

quickInfo.name: Team One variant
quickInfo.summary: Use the Team One route below: it has six numbered lanes, soccer-ball lamps, and add-a-ball awards that are commonly converted to points for tournaments.

fallback.title: Number lanes
fallback.when: Use this plan when the center target or drop rebounds are unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the outer 1 and 4 lanes.
Use the lower inlanes to complete missing numbers.
Complete 1-2-3-4 to score and raise the target value.

alternatives.title: Team One add-a-ball route
alternatives.when: Use this route on the 1977 Team One add-a-ball version, especially when its add-a-ball awards are converted to points.

steps.text: Plunge a missing number; prefer 2 or 3 if the outer lanes can return down the center.
Complete all six numbered lanes while taking lit soccer-ball targets when their rebounds are controlled.
Work through both five-target banks. From a cradle, backhand an exposed upper number or lit target when that angle is repeatable.
When add-a-balls are converted for competition, prioritize the converted point awards over unsafe completion attempts.
Complete 1-2-3-4 repeatedly.
Hit the lit center target after completing the required drop bank.
